# Retrospective: PR 12646

## What worked
- Bounded coordinator policy/source reads and read-only triage preceded reviewer launches.
- Exact fresh Claude Code Opus 5.5 High and Pi GPT 6 Sol Xhigh native identities verified; no alternate auth/model/runtime. No previous technical memory reported.
- Peer finals remained unread until both were saved. Source-only Sol assessment provided an independent limit on live-behavior claims.
- Two focused assertion checks exposed a concrete false positive without running the full desktop or stock script.
- Coordinator examined raw child outcomes, fixture scripts, mutants and archive-source hashes rather than accepting seal/summary alone.

## Deviations and remediation
1. Opus read approximately 303 policy lines in parallel, exceeding the aggregate 60-line bound (some chunks also exceeded 60). It subsequently read complete policy content; native oversized-output persistence is unknown, no reported persistence warning. Preserve native history. All future assignment policy reads are explicitly sequential, no parallel groups.
2. Initial assignment cut projection happened not to truncate (maximum actual line 1406, limit 2000); later source projections did truncate selected lines and are not treated as a full source read. Coordinator's direct full relevant source and exact retained files support the narrowed claims. Never project policy/source text and call it complete.
3. Host which perl/realpath/grep was a prohibited external capability probe. Excluded from validation evidence; every such future check belongs inside review.py. The actual assertion executions used review.py with private namespaces.
4. No separate pre-extraction archive-member inventory was recorded. Tool member/type filtering and single-file fixture repository constrained contents, and post-hoc coordinator hashing confirmed exact pinned source bytes. This does not repair prior compliance; retain the deviation and require an explicit pre-extraction inventory next time.
5. Receipt sibling targets were not all individually asserted when saving blobs. Disposable repo mkdir/cp setup lacked retained streams, Git/tool internal writes were contained but not individually guarded. These are setup/guard limits, not a claim of complete per-target compliance. Fixture mutation/output targets were individually resolved beneath REVIEW_OUTPUT. No symlink-race protection is claimed.
6. Original Opus prose overclaimed whole-suite mutant survival and initial configure timing. Preserve independent final.md, attach audit-addendum.md, exclude both overclaims. The public draft contains only individual assertion outcomes and settled source mechanism.

PROCESS-CORRECTION.md remedies responsible assignment instructions: sequential <=60-line reads, no projections, isolated capability probes, and explicit assertion-only/timing boundaries. Opus acknowledged the correction in a saved addendum. Do not describe this review as fully process-compliant.

## Cleanup and storage
No desktop/service/background resources were started. Both command runs finished and their private namespace state was discarded. Opus confirms no outstanding owned handles. Sol ran no experiments. Preserve pinned source, disposable fixture repo, failed/invalid or excluded history, raw outputs and reviewer sessions. No pattern-based killing or global process discovery. No private HTML page opened.

## Tool issues and next steps
No confirmed toolkit defect. A pinned-blob source mode could reduce single-file repository setup friction, but is a feature suggestion only. Live compositor validation would answer the unresolved central behavior; do not substitute more regex checks for it. No next PR selected by this coordinator.

No production defect was identified in the source review. The empty-desktop drag fix still needs independent live validation.

**Verified by source inspection:** only the moving panel expands, remains on the Top layer, and keeps its strip content at the original edge. The gesture area grows with the panel; release/cancel clears the move. The Overlay previews remain input-transparent.

```text
Idle strip -> moving panel fills its output -> release/cancel restores strip
              same MouseArea, same Top layer
```

**Optional test improvement:** the [four-anchor assertion](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/8aeea9e4468a95b23a2deaae54590bf1ee9a8794/test/shell.d/bar-test.sh#L48-L54) can match `moveExpanded` occurrences after the `anchors` block. An isolated assertion check demonstrated:

| Input | Current assertion | Block-scoped check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PR source | Pass | Pass |
| Diagnostic copy with expansion removed from all four anchors | Pass | Fail |

Constrain the match to the `anchors` block and check `top`, `bottom`, `left` and `right` individually. This catches removal of the mechanism the test is intended to protect. These are assertion-only results, not a complete-suite run or a production regression.
